neighbours.label: the piece ' vel' opening a Latin species epithet (velutina, velox, velutinum), and ' intr' in M. intracellulare; ' vel'/' intr' in ordinary words (velour, Velcro, intravenous) and other epithets stay quiet
fire: The shrub Banksia velutina grows on sandy ridges.
Collectors prize the tiny gecko Hemidactylus velox for its speed.
In the greenhouse we potted a cutting of Kalanchoe velutina yesterday.
A swab from the second patient grew M. intracellulare within a month.
The fungus Flammulina velutipes is sold as enoki.
Among the grasses, Bromus velutinus was the most common.
The hornet Vespa velutina has spread across France.
Sputum cultures were again positive for M. intracellulare in March.

notes: Card: ' vel' (velutina, velox) and ' intr' (M. intracellulare) among mixed peaks (' and', ' r', Korean). Probes: Dendrobium velutinum 0.98, Raphionacme velutina 0.75, T. b. velox 0.71, M. intracellulare 0.46; velour, Velcro, intrathecal, intramural, intravenous, S. aureus, E. coli, Quercus robur all 0.00. The + pole fires on ' пов'(едение) and suppresses 'behavior', so the unit is about next-piece prediction; this label covers only the Latin-epithet part of the - pole.
